description: MCP server audit: connects to a remote MCP server (or takes its tools, resources and prompts), grades it A-F for tool poisoning, hidden Unicode, raw command/path inputs, destructive tools without annotations, name shadowing, resources pointing at credentials, poisoned prompts and insecure transport. Use before connecting an agent to an MCP server you did not write, or when a user asks whether an MCP server is safe. Pass url (Streamable HTTP; initialize, tools/list and, when advertised, resources/list and prompts/list are called, nothing is invoked or read) or tools[] (plus optional resources[] and prompts[]) from your own list calls for stdio servers. Returns grade A-F, score 0-100, verdict, server {name, version, protocolVersion, https, auth, capabilities}, toolCount, resourceCount, promptCount, findings[] {rule, severity, message, tool|resource|prompt, evidence}, tools[], resources[] and prompts[] each with risk and finding count. Any poisoning finding caps the grade at D. Not charged when the server is down or needs auth. Price: $0.005 per call from Exepal credit; not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls.

headers.description: With url: headers to send, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}. Used for the audit only, never stored

instructions.description: With tools[]: the server's instructions string from initialize

prompts.description: With tools[]: the server's prompts from prompts/list

resources.description: With tools[]: the server's resources from resources/list and resources/templates/list

tools.description: Instead of url: the server's tools as returned by tools/list (for stdio servers or servers behind auth)

url.description: Remote MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP), e.g. https://example.com/mcp

name: scan_mcp

grade.description: A, B, C, D or F

auth.description: none (tools listed without credentials), required or unknown

title: MCP server audit
